verdict.rationale: Anthropic's skills are documented as plain folders with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions, and the open agentskills.io specification (name, description, directory structure) matches this exact format, with fields like the 1-1024 character description requirement mirrored in Anthropic's own SKILL.md templates. A recorded runtime probe further shows a third-party CLI tool (not Anthropic's) successfully fetching and installing a skill folder from Anthropic's repo with clean frontmatter, demonstrating real cross-tool portability without any Anthropic account. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement from Anthropic committing to spec conformance/versioning, and broader evidence of multiple independent (non-Anthropic) tools consuming the same skill folders.
